rows.verbatim: The Contractor shall furnish the federal facility and provide all services inclusive of a trained and qualified management staff, supervision, manpower, relief officers, uniforms, equipment, vehicles, and supplies (which includes firearms, ammunition, body restraints, non-lethal devices, body armor, radios, and cellular telephones) to provide support seven (7) days per week, twenty-four (24) hours per day.
rows.normalized: Contractor must furnish the federal facility and provide all listed services/staff/equipment 24/7.

rows.verbatim: The contractor shall provide safe and secure conditions of confinement based on the individual characteristics of a diverse population, including threat to the community, risk of flight, type and status of immigration proceeding, community ties, medical and behavioral health issues.
rows.normalized: Contractor must provide safe and secure conditions of confinement based on detainee characteristics.

rows.verbatim: The federal detention facility shall provide easy access to legal services; abundant natural light throughout the federal detention facility; ample indoor and outdoor recreation shall be offered at a reasonable time of day.
rows.normalized: Contractor must provide legal service access, natural light, and reasonably-timed recreation at the facility.

rows.verbatim: Weather permitting, each detainee shall have access for at least one hour per day, five days per week, that allows for vigorous aerobic exercise with extended hours of availability.
rows.normalized: Contractor must ensure each detainee has at least one hour/day, five days/week of vigorous aerobic exercise access, weather permitting.

rows.verbatim: The contractor shall also provide private showers and restrooms (where practicable); cafeteria style meal service or satellite feeding; institutional alien clothing; contact and non-contact visitation in accordance with NDS 2026; private areas for attorney-client visits, with video teleconferencing capabilities; noise control; enhanced, but controlled freedom of movement (although the manner and degree of implementation may vary based on security levels); enhanced law library and legal resources (including computers with limited web access to accommodate the ICE provided online law library via the ICE Portal); and enhanced programming, including religious services and social programs and dedicated space for religious services.
rows.normalized: Contractor must provide private showers/restrooms, meal service, clothing, visitation, attorney visit areas, noise control, freedom of movement, law library, and programming per NDS 2026.

rows.verbatim: In addition to comprehensive detention services, the Contractor shall provide comprehensive operations and maintenance (O&M) services including ongoing preventive and corrective maintenance, facility operations, post-closing services, and compliance with safety, environmental, medical, IT/communications, accessibility, pest control, and security requirements.
rows.normalized: Contractor must provide comprehensive O&M services including maintenance, facility operations, post-closing services, and compliance with listed requirement areas.

rows.verbatim: ample indoor and outdoor recreation shall be offered at a reasonable time of day.
rows.normalized: The contractor must offer indoor and outdoor recreation at a reasonable time of day.

rows.verbatim: All work shall be performed in accordance with the applicable ICE detention standards, applicable codes, and regulatory requirements.
rows.normalized: Contractor must perform all work in accordance with applicable ICE detention standards, codes, and regulations.

rows.verbatim: Detention services shall be performed in accordance with the most current version of the applicable ICE detention standards listed in the Addendum – Facility-Specific Requirements.
rows.normalized: Contractor must perform detention services per the most current applicable ICE detention standards in the Addendum.

rows.verbatim: The contractor shall be responsible for obtaining and maintaining American Correctional Association (ACA) Adult Local Detention Facilities (ALDF) accreditation.
rows.normalized: Contractor must obtain and maintain ACA ALDF accreditation.

rows.verbatim: Conformance with the ACA ALDF Standards is required on the first day of contract performance and accreditation shall be obtained within seven (7) months of the contract award.
rows.normalized: Contractor must conform to ACA ALDF Standards on day one and obtain accreditation within 7 months of award.

rows.verbatim: If the federal facility is already accredited, reaccreditation shall occur as required by ACA.
rows.normalized: If the facility is already accredited, contractor must obtain reaccreditation as required by ACA.

rows.verbatim: The federal facility shall meet, at a minimum, all ACA ALDF requirements and the requirements of the applicable ICE detention standards.
rows.normalized: Contractor must ensure the facility meets, at a minimum, all ACA ALDF requirements and applicable ICE detention standards.

rows.verbatim: The Contractor shall furnish all personnel, management, equipment, supplies, training, certification, accreditation, and services necessary for the performance of all aspects of the contract.
rows.normalized: Contractor must furnish all personnel, equipment, training, certification, and services necessary for contract performance.

rows.verbatim: Unless explicitly stated otherwise, the contractor is responsible for all costs associated with and incurred as part of providing the services outlined in this contract.
rows.normalized: Contractor is responsible for all costs of providing services under the contract unless stated otherwise.

rows.verbatim: Unless explicitly stated otherwise, the contractor is responsible for all costs associated with and incurred in providing the services specified in this contract.
rows.normalized: Contractor is responsible for all costs of providing specified services unless stated otherwise.

rows.verbatim: The Contractor shall provide fully operational radios assigned to each detention officer (including relief officers).
rows.normalized: Contractor must provide fully operational radios to each detention officer, including relief officers.

rows.verbatim: The contractor will maintain a serviceable, in stock, backup quantity of radios that are adequate for all staff and enough to cover backup staff and/or repairs and downtime.
rows.normalized: Contractor must maintain a serviceable backup stock of radios adequate for all staff and downtime.

rows.verbatim: The Contractor will provide for the secure custody, care, and safekeeping of aliens in accordance with the federal laws, standards, policies, procedures for firearms requirements, or court orders applicable to the operations of the federal facility.
rows.normalized: Contractor must provide secure custody, care, and safekeeping of aliens per applicable laws, standards, and policies.

rows.verbatim: The contractor shall enforce disciplinary actions against any alien who is not in compliance with the rules and procedures of the federal facility in accordance with the applicable ICE detention standards and applicable ICE policy.
rows.normalized: Contractor must enforce disciplinary actions against non-compliant aliens per ICE standards and policy.

rows.verbatim: The federal facility shall include a special management unit(s) for administrative and discipline segregation.
rows.normalized: Contractor must include special management unit(s) for administrative and discipline segregation at the facility.

rows.verbatim: If any conflicts between federal, state, or local laws or rules arise, the federal rules shall be followed.
rows.normalized: If conflicts arise between federal, state, or local laws, contractor must follow federal rules.

rows.verbatim: The contractor does not have a right of refusal and shall take all referrals from ICE.
rows.normalized: Contractor must accept all referrals from ICE and has no right of refusal.

rows.verbatim: In the case of an alien already at the federal facility, the contractor shall notify the ICE designee and COR and request transfer of the alien from the federal facility.
rows.normalized: If an alien already at the facility needs alternative care, contractor must notify ICE designee/COR and request transfer.

rows.verbatim: The contractor shall permit ICE reasonable time to make alternative arrangements for the alien.
rows.normalized: Contractor must permit ICE reasonable time to make alternative arrangements for the alien.

rows.verbatim: Approved inspectors shall always have full access to the federal facility and in all areas of performance.
rows.normalized: Contractor must allow approved inspectors full access to the facility and all performance areas at all times.

rows.verbatim: The contractor shall provide full and complete cooperation for all requests related to detention oversight or investigation conducted by the government or approved third-party inspectors on behalf of the government.
rows.normalized: Contractor must fully cooperate with all government/third-party oversight or investigation requests.

rows.verbatim: Upon discovery that an alien may be a juvenile, the contractor shall immediately notify the COR or ICE designee and follow the instructions of the COR or ICE designee.
rows.normalized: If an alien may be a juvenile, contractor must immediately notify the COR/ICE designee and follow their instructions.

rows.verbatim: The contractor will not house any non-ICE population at the federal facility without the express prior written approval of the CO.
rows.normalized: Contractor must not house any non-ICE population without prior written CO approval.

rows.verbatim: Should a change in the applicable standards and laws identified in this contract result in a documentable financial impact on the contractor, the contractor must notify the CO within 30 calendar days of receipt of the change and both contractor and Government will negotiate best course of action, either 1) a waiver to the Standards or, 2) to negotiate a prospective change in the bed day or other rates.
rows.normalized: If a standards/law change financially impacts the contractor, contractor must notify the CO within 30 calendar days of receipt of the change.

rows.verbatim: For safety, security, and sanitation purposes, an inspection of housing areas shall be conducted by a supervisor at a minimum of once per shift.
rows.normalized: Contractor must conduct a supervisor inspection of housing areas at a minimum of once per shift.

rows.verbatim: The inspection shall be logged into the security logbook and available for review by the COR and/or ICE official.
rows.normalized: Contractor must log inspections in the security logbook, available for COR/ICE review.

rows.verbatim: All locks, windows, walls, floors, ventilators, covers, access panels, and doors shall be checked daily for operational wear and tampering.
rows.normalized: Contractor must check all locks, windows, walls, floors, ventilators, covers, access panels, and doors daily for wear/tampering.

rows.verbatim: The Contractor shall take immediate action to repair all defective equipment.
rows.normalized: Contractor must take immediate action to repair all defective equipment.

rows.verbatim: The federal facility shall be subject to periodic and random inspections by the COR, an ICE official, or other federal government officials to ensure compliance with ICE Standards.
